purpose: One frozen cross-site historical transfer stress test. The multi-rate causal early-departure envelope was selected only with Caltech May/June development artifacts. JPL October sessions are acquired only after this configuration and the selection record exist, and are never used to alter the selected guard, controller, metrics, or scenario settings. This is not a real-time prospective deployment and does not identify a measured JPL feeder or PV system.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in use the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture. The later disconnectTime is a hidden environment event and must never be a controller input.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from the primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy, not historical delivered energy.

commitment_uncertainty.deployment_rule: At each JPL plug-in, each fixed expert may use Caltech April calibration scores and only realized JPL unplug outcomes observed at or before that plug-in. The controller receives the earliest of the experts' causal deadlines.
commitment_uncertainty.selection_protocol: The multi-rate envelope with learning rates {0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02} was selected using the predeclared coverage-first comparison of Caltech May and unchanged June artifacts. The JPL test file is acquired and evaluated only after this protocol is frozen.
commitment_uncertainty.scope: Cross-site empirical stress test of an operational conservative causal envelope. It is not AgACI itself and does not provide finite-sample, per-driver, conditional, or cross-site coverage guarantees.

multi_rate_envelope.reference: Gibbs and Candès (NeurIPS 2021), Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift; Zaffran et al. (ICML 2022), Adaptive Conformal Predictions for Time Series. This implementation is a transparent conservative expert envelope, not AgACI's learned aggregation.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Caltech calibration commitments initialize the guard; JPL sessions form an untouched workplace-site transfer test. Both are mapped to the same synthetic feeder stations for a controlled policy comparison.

solar_data.note: A fixed regional GHI resource proxy shared across the controlled experiments; it is not measured JPL rooftop PV output.

pv_proxy_sensitivity.note: PVWatts GHI proxy for a controlled sensitivity experiment; it is not measured JPL PV production.

feeder_sensitivity.note: A deliberately severe synthetic shared feeder-import budget used equally across sites; it is not a measured JPL feeder limit.
